name: Nanbu (Tottori, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nanbu town emblem in blue, yellow and pink: a blue stylised figure with a yellow head and a pink blossom.
history: Municipal flag of Nanbu, a town in Tottori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 7 December 2004.

features.role: Nanbu town emblem — a blue stylised figure with a yellow head and a pink blossom
